about: Answer key for a second, made-up check-call-summary test, written by hand with the call and summaries on 19 Nov 2026, before any checker ran. Line numbers are those the number command gives halvercombe-follow-up.txt. Halvercombe Homes and everyone named are fictional; the company name was searched and no match found. Fixed before any run: the company name was put into a spoken line (L7), and 'Ideally' kept on the go-live lines in both summaries.

doubtful_label_traps.25: Joe: 'Thanks, Raj, that's helpful.' Correctly labelled: Joe thanks Raj.
doubtful_label_traps.27: Raj: 'Dana's being polite.' Correctly labelled: Raj talks about Dana.
doubtful_label_traps.31: Gemma: 'Sorry, Gemma here, I've just joined.' Correctly labelled: she names herself.

planted.line: Dana said single sign-on with Microsoft is a must-have.
planted.why: Raj says it (L20), and L20's label is not doubtful.

planted.line: Raj would pay a premium to replace the spreadsheets.
planted.why: L16 'I'd pay double just to never open that spreadsheet again.' Dana: 'Don't tell him that, Raj. [laughs]' (L17). Raj: 'scrap that. Strike it from the record.' (L18).
No number of users is said anywhere on the call.
Gemma: 'If the business case stacks up I don't see a problem. But it's not my call alone.' (L35). Nothing was approved.

planted.line: Raj has completed the security questionnaire.
planted.why: Raj: 'I'll get the security questionnaire back to you, but it has to go past our DPO first, so give it a couple of weeks.' (L22).

planted.line: Dana to send the contract register export tomorrow.
planted.why: Raj: 'I can send you an export of the contract register... I'll do it tomorrow.' (L24); Joe confirms 'Raj, the export tomorrow' (L25, L42). Wrong owner.

clean: **Attendees:** Dana Whitlock, Raj Sandhu, Gemma Okafor, Joe Ferris
Roughly 400 live contracts, tracked in spreadsheets.
Three contracts auto-renewed last year after notice dates were missed, including lift maintenance.
Indicative price around £38k a year, to be firmed up once Joe has seen the register.
Joe to send a revised proposal on Friday.
Joe to draft a one-page business case and send it to Dana.

left_out.why: Anything above fifty thousand over the whole contract goes to the audit committee. The summary never says so.
left_out.accept: missing, or carried wrongly against the 'Gemma has approved the budget' claim. Either is right.

rep-note.why: A terse but accurate rep note. Number conversions (3,200, c.400, £38k/yr, £50k) and short forms (SSO, Jan, Mar, Fri) are fair. Any failure on any claim is a false alarm.

pass_rule: Every quote verifies. All 6 planted failures in notetaker-2 caught with the right type. No failure on any clean line of notetaker-2 or any line of rep-note. The audit committee rule listed as a who-decides key fact and marked missing, or carried wrongly against the approved-budget claim, for notetaker-2. No line flagged as a doubtful label. Extra failure types on a planted line and extra left-out key facts are notes, not failures.
